questions.prompt: Where does the conversation take place?
questions.explanation: Dictionaries, novels và pay at the counter cho thấy cuộc trò chuyện ở hiệu sách.
questions.transcript: Woman: Excuse me, where can I find the English dictionaries? Man: They are on the shelf beside the novels. You can pay at the counter near the entrance.

questions.prompt: What is the speaker introducing?
questions.explanation: Các hoạt động vẽ, học từ màu sắc và hát nằm trong một buổi học.

questions.transcript: Thank you for calling the town swimming pool. We are closed this morning because the water is being checked. We expect to open again after lunch.

questions.prompt: What would the customer prefer?
questions.explanation: Khách ưu tiên nhận áo màu xanh nếu còn hàng, không phải phương án hoàn tiền được đề nghị.
questions.transcript: I ordered the blue jacket, but the package contained a black one. Customer service offered a refund, although I would prefer the blue jacket if it is still available.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the workshop?
options: To prepare volunteers to assist visitors
questions.explanation: Buổi tập huấn giúp tình nguyện viên hỗ trợ khách tham quan.
questions.transcript: The workshop will help volunteers welcome visitors, answer common questions and guide people to accessible entrances. No previous experience is required.

questions.prompt: When must the designs be sent?
questions.explanation: Hạn gửi bản thiết kế là thứ Tư; thứ Sáu là ngày phát áp phích.
questions.transcript: The original deadline was Thursday, but the printer needs an extra day. Please send your final designs by Wednesday so we can still distribute the posters on Friday.

questions.prompt: Which principle does the speaker emphasise?
options: Using the same objectives for everyone
questions.explanation: Trọng tâm là mục tiêu học tập cá nhân và việc xem lại mục tiêu.
questions.transcript: The evaluation found that the mentoring scheme worked best when participants set their own objectives and reviewed them regularly. Matching people by job title alone was less useful than considering their learning goals.

questions.prompt: What must happen before funding is released?
options: The accessibility plan must receive an independent review
A supplier must lower its price
The committee must cancel the project
questions.explanation: Điều kiện giải ngân là đánh giá độc lập kế hoạch tiếp cận, không chỉ dự toán chi phí.
questions.transcript: The committee approved the renovation in principle, but funding will not be released until the revised accessibility plan has been independently reviewed. A cost estimate alone will not satisfy that condition.

questions.prompt: What approach is the manager describing?
options: Using repeated problems to improve a shared process
Moving all work to one department
questions.explanation: Người quản lý tìm mẫu lặp để cải thiện quy trình bàn giao chung.
questions.transcript: Rather than treating every complaint as an isolated mistake, the manager examined recurring patterns across departments. The resulting changes focused on handover procedures, not on assigning blame to individual staff.

questions.prompt: What time does the tour begin?
questions.explanation: Chuyến tham quan bắt đầu lúc ten thirty.
questions.transcript: Welcome to the Riverside Museum. Our tour begins at the main entrance at ten thirty and lasts one hour. You may leave large bags in the lockers beside the ticket desk. The first room introduces the history of the town. After that, we will visit the transport gallery on the second floor. Photography is allowed without flash, but please do not take photographs of the temporary exhibition. The cafe stays open until four o'clock. If you leave the group, ask a member of staff to help you find us again. Please keep your ticket with you during the visit.

questions.prompt: What information should be compared with completed bookings?
questions.explanation: Người nói yêu cầu so sánh completed bookings với website visits.
questions.transcript: Before we decide whether to extend the online booking trial, I would like the team to review the evidence carefully. The number of telephone enquiries has fallen, but that does not by itself prove that the new system is easier to use. Some customers may simply have given up. Please compare completed bookings with website visits and read the comments from customers who left before payment. We should also keep telephone support available during the review. If the evidence shows that customers can complete their bookings more reliably, I will recommend a wider rollout. Otherwise, we should improve the difficult steps and repeat the trial before making a long-term commitment.

questions.prompt: What is the speaker mainly asking the team to do?
options: Evaluate the trial using several kinds of evidence
questions.explanation: Nhóm cần đánh giá thử nghiệm từ nhiều nguồn thông tin.

questions.prompt: The shop opens at nine and closes at six. When does it close?
questions.explanation: Câu cho biết cửa hàng đóng lúc sáu giờ.

questions.prompt: The notice says: Return library books by Friday, 12 June. What is the deadline?
questions.explanation: Cụm by Friday, 12 June nêu hạn trả sách.

questions.prompt: A bus ticket costs $4 for adults and $2 for children. How much does one adult pay?
questions.explanation: Giá vé cho một người lớn là $4.

questions.prompt: An office notice asks staff to save their work because all computers will restart at 5 p.m. What is its main purpose?
options: To warn about a planned restart
questions.explanation: Thông báo yêu cầu lưu công việc trước khi máy khởi động lại.

questions.prompt: A community email invites residents to bring reusable bags, repair old clothes and exchange unwanted books. What is the central theme?
questions.explanation: Các hoạt động đều giúp giảm đồ bỏ đi.

questions.prompt: A guide recommends walking to nearby places, using stairs and taking short movement breaks at work. What does it mainly encourage?
options: More physical activity in daily life
questions.explanation: Các gợi ý đều nhằm tăng vận động trong sinh hoạt thường ngày.

questions.prompt: The report argues that flexible schedules succeed only when teams agree on availability, document decisions and evaluate outcomes rather than hours online. What is the main argument?
options: Flexible work needs explicit coordination and outcome-based evaluation
All teams should adopt identical schedules
questions.explanation: Trọng tâm là phối hợp rõ ràng và đánh giá kết quả, không chỉ thời gian trực tuyến.

questions.prompt: The supplier can meet the original price only if the order is confirmed today. The manager postpones the decision until next week. What can reasonably be inferred?
options: The supplier has cancelled every order
The manager accepted the current offer
The original price is guaranteed next week
The original price may no longer be available
questions.explanation: Điều kiện giữ giá là xác nhận hôm nay, nên trì hoãn có thể làm mất mức giá đó.

questions.prompt: Although attendance at the workshop doubled, the organisers retained the small-group format by recruiting extra facilitators. What does this suggest?
options: They reduced the number of activities
questions.explanation: Thêm người hướng dẫn để giữ nhóm nhỏ cho thấy họ coi trọng sự tham gia.

questions.prompt: The reviewer praises the tool for expert users but notes that its unexplained terminology may discourage newcomers. Which recommendation follows?
questions.explanation: Giải thích thuật ngữ giúp người mới tiếp cận mà vẫn giữ chức năng cho chuyên gia.

units.passage: Oakwood Library is open from Monday to Friday, from 8:30 a.m. to 7 p.m. On Saturdays and Sundays, it is open from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. Members can borrow up to five books at a time. The quiet study room and computer lab are on the second floor. Please do not bring food or drinks into the study room. Children under ten must come with an adult.

questions.prompt: What is the notice mainly about?
options: Rules and opening hours of a library
questions.explanation: Đoạn văn giới thiệu giờ mở cửa và quy tắc của thư viện.

questions.prompt: What time does the library close on weekdays?
questions.explanation: Ngày thường thư viện đóng cửa lúc 7 p.m.

questions.prompt: How many books can a member borrow at one time?
questions.explanation: Đoạn văn ghi up to five books at a time.

questions.prompt: Where is the quiet study room?
questions.explanation: Phòng học yên tĩnh ở tầng hai.

questions.prompt: What must children under ten do?
questions.explanation: Trẻ dưới mười tuổi cần có người lớn đi cùng.

units.passage: The Green Route bus takes visitors from Central Station to Lake Park. Buses leave every thirty minutes from 8 a.m. until 6 p.m. The trip takes twenty minutes. A return ticket costs six dollars and can be bought from the driver. Children under five travel free. Passengers should keep their tickets for the return trip. On Sunday, the last bus from the park leaves at 5 p.m. Visitors who want more time at the park should travel earlier in the day.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of this text?
options: To explain a bus service for visitors
questions.explanation: Đoạn văn cung cấp thông tin chuyến xe đến công viên.

questions.prompt: How long is the trip from the station to the park?
questions.explanation: The trip takes twenty minutes.

questions.prompt: Where can passengers buy a ticket?
questions.explanation: Vé có thể mua từ tài xế.

questions.prompt: Which heading best fits the text?
options: Getting to Lake Park by Bus
questions.explanation: Nội dung chính là di chuyển bằng xe buýt đến Lake Park.

questions.prompt: Why does the text suggest travelling earlier on Sunday?
options: Tickets cost less in the morning
questions.explanation: Chuyến cuối ngày Chủ nhật rời công viên lúc 5 giờ, sớm hơn lịch thông thường.

units.passage: To reduce interruptions during the pilot project, Northgate Design will introduce two quiet work periods each day, from 9 to 11 and from 2 to 4. During these periods, non-urgent questions should be posted in the team channel rather than discussed at desks. The reception desk will still handle urgent client calls. Managers are asked to gather feedback after two weeks. The arrangement is temporary: a permanent decision will depend on whether staff report better concentration without slower responses to clients. Teams may propose adjustments, but they should support suggestions with examples from the pilot.

questions.prompt: When is the afternoon quiet work period?
questions.explanation: Khoảng làm việc yên tĩnh buổi chiều từ 2 đến 4.

questions.prompt: What is the main aim of the pilot?
options: To reduce the number of employees
To protect concentration while maintaining client service
To close the office to visitors
questions.explanation: Đoạn văn nêu mục tiêu tăng tập trung mà không làm chậm phản hồi khách hàng.

questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the proposed approach?
options: Stop all communication throughout the day
Allow only managers to ask questions
Test structured quiet periods and evaluate the results
questions.explanation: Đây là thử nghiệm có lấy phản hồi trước khi quyết định lâu dài.

questions.prompt: A client has an urgent problem at 10 a.m. What should happen?
options: Reception should still handle the call
The client must wait until tomorrow
The team channel must be closed
questions.explanation: Các cuộc gọi khách hàng khẩn cấp vẫn do lễ tân xử lý.

questions.prompt: Why are examples requested with suggested adjustments?
options: To identify who asked most questions
To base changes on evidence from the trial
questions.explanation: Ví dụ từ thử nghiệm giúp đề xuất thay đổi có căn cứ.

units.passage: Brightfield Cooperative initially considered replacing its delivery fleet to reduce emissions. However, a review found that poorly coordinated routes caused many vehicles to travel partly empty. The cooperative therefore postponed the purchase and tested shared scheduling with two neighbouring suppliers. After the trial, delivery distances fell while order volumes remained stable. The report cautions that the outcome may not transfer directly to regions with less predictable demand. It recommends improving scheduling first, then assessing whether new vehicles would provide additional benefits. Although the trial required staff training and compatible booking systems, these costs were lower than the immediate purchase of a new fleet. The cooperative will revisit the investment decision once a full year of operating data is available.

questions.prompt: When will the cooperative revisit its investment decision?
options: After a full year of operating data
questions.explanation: Quyết định đầu tư được xem lại khi có dữ liệu vận hành đủ một năm.

questions.prompt: What is the report's central recommendation?
options: Improve coordination before evaluating further investment
questions.explanation: Khuyến nghị là cải thiện lịch trình trước rồi đánh giá lợi ích đầu tư thêm.

questions.prompt: What most likely prompted the decision to postpone the purchase?
options: Evidence that existing capacity was being used inefficiently
A permanent ban on new vehicles
A large reduction in order volume
questions.explanation: Xe chạy chưa đầy do điều phối kém cho thấy công suất hiện có chưa được khai thác tốt.

questions.prompt: Why does the report mention regions with unpredictable demand?
options: To show that all regions achieved the same outcome
To limit how broadly the findings should be generalised
To recommend ending delivery services there
To prove that vehicle technology is irrelevant
questions.explanation: Đây là giới hạn khi áp dụng kết quả thử nghiệm cho bối cảnh khác.

questions.prompt: Which conclusion is supported by the comparison of costs?
options: New vehicles could never be useful
The trial was a less costly initial step than immediate replacement
Shared scheduling eliminated the need for future review
questions.explanation: Thử nghiệm có chi phí nhưng thấp hơn mua cả đội xe ngay lập tức.
